title: Notches Currency
description: A comprehensive server-side economy mod that introduces a secure currency system with ATMs, player trading, and NPC integration support.
body:
# Notches Currency

**A complete, server-side economy mod for currency, banking, player shops, an auction house, a deeply customizable NPC system, casino games, and a full suite of money sinks and faucets to keep your server's economy balanced.**

## Features

### Currency & Banking
- A secure, server-validated **virtual balance** with persistent storage and a full audit log
- **Physical coins** you can carry, drop, and trade — convert to/from your balance at an ATM / Bank block
- An always-visible **balance HUD** with a smooth animated counter and a custom coin symbol in chat, HUD, and on the item
- **`/receipts`** — your recent transaction history (what moved, what for, when)

### Currency Creator
Rebrand the coin for your server. Give it a **custom name and artwork** and it applies **everywhere** — the item, the HUD, the chat symbol, and every message and GUI. On a server the coin is **pushed to every player automatically** on join, so there's no resource pack to hand out. Want your economy to run on *Rubies*, *Credits*, or *Dubloons*? One PNG and a name.

### Player Shops
- Code-drawn, fully paginated **browse / manage / listing** screens (up to 27 listings)
- Price in **coins, a bartered item, or both at once**
- Live earnings, open/close and rent controls, and **`&`-color-coded shop titles**
- Run by an NPC — add dialogue and shoppers get a conversation *before* the shop opens

### Auction House
- **Buy-now and timed auctions** with bidding, offline-safe outbid refunds, and a winnings mailbox
- Fully GUI-driven: browse, list, bid, and cancel in-screen
- Scaling, configurable **listing fees and sale tax**

### Player-to-Player Trading
- Secure live trades with both-party confirmation, plus **offline trade offers** for when the other player isn't online

### Deep NPC System
One blank-slate NPC item spawns a fully customizable NPC (built on GeckoLib):
- **Appearance** — vanilla humanoid, GeckoLib models, or disguise as any entity; preset / player / URL skins
- **Behaviors** — stationary, wander, follow, patrol, or guard (with hostility & fight-back options)
- **Poses** — presets plus a live custom-pose editor, and idle animation styles
- **A visual branching Dialogue Studio** — pages, choices, per-choice actions (open a shop, pay/charge coins, give items, admin-gated commands) and requirements, with a live client-side preview
- **Quick Lines** — for simple random chatter
- Stats, protection, ownership-gated editing, saveable presets, a "pick up" that repacks the NPC into the item, and a public API for other mods

### Economy Roles
Assign any NPC a role: **Shop, Banker, Auctioneer, Mailbox, Raffle, Bounty, Dealer (casino), Enchanter, or Cosmetics** — plus admin server-shops.

### Sinks & Faucets
Keep the economy in check:
- **Faucets** — bounty board, crates & keys, gambling wins, raffles, loans, world drops
- **Sinks** — enchanter (repair / buy enchants / extract to book / uncraft), gambling bets, raffle cut, wealth tax, shop rent, auction fees, an optional Waystone teleport fee
- **Villager coin trades** — villagers can rarely roll trades priced in coins instead of emeralds

### Blocks & Casino Props
Hand-modeled, some animated:
- **ATM / Bank**, **Slot Machine** (animated marquee), and a **Coin Flip table** with a 3D coin that pops up, tumbles, and lands on the result
- **Crates** (Common / Rare / Epic) — arched treasure chests whose lids swing open on a win
- **Bounty Board** — a two-tall notice board for the rotating bounty list
- **Ledger Board** — a wide monument that renders the live balance leaderboard right on its face, in real time

### World Events
Balloon crates and golden caches spawn around the world for players to find.

### Admin & Config
- `/eco give|take|set|stats`, a `/baltop` leaderboard, and a physical Ledger Board
- Optional Discord webhook for admin-relevant transactions
- A **positional bounty-tracker HUD** (toggle **B**), placeable so it dodges other mods' overlays
- A full in-game **settings screen (ModMenu)** with live search — nearly everything is configurable

---

## Dependencies
- **Fabric API** — required
- **GeckoLib** — required (the NPC system runs on it)
- **ModMenu** — optional (opens the config screen)
- **Waystones** — optional (enables the teleport fee)
